signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Shutdown defenders have the talent to erase receivers from the game. When they enter the zone, their coverage is tighter and interceptions are more frequent on contested catches.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and inside the numbers.
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move
Blockers with this ability will allow less frequent shed attempts by their block target
Blockers with this ability are almost guaranteed to win any double team block they are engaged in
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.
Blockers with this ability will allow less frequent shed attempts by their block target
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against inside run plays.
Defenders with this ability can apply pressure to the quarterback from a greater distance.
Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone
When lined up as a tight end; players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments; and react more promptly to playmaker inputs.
Avoid stumbling when carrying the ball
Kickers with this ability experience a slower kicking meter for better power and accuracy on kicks up to 45 yards.
Kickers with this ability are immune to the 'Ice the Kicker' effect that occurs after opponents call timeouts in critical situations.
Kickers with this ability can see the entirety of the kicking arc
